dsh-handoff 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。每个工作目录与 git 分支自动维护 handoff.md：记录回合、折叠为简洁 Markdown 并注入后续会话，存储于 ~/.agent/agent-handoff，与 pi-handoff 字节级兼容。

posts.en:
dsh-handoff is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Self-maintaining handoff memory per working directory and git branch: records turns, folds them into concise Markdown, and injects the result into future sessions from ~/.agent/agent-handoff, byte-compatible with pi-handoff.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-ccf8220de3fbd2fde22f.html
